A unified trading interface and agentic CLI will bring market research, strategy development and execution together.

The future of finance doesn't have opening or closing hours. Neither should its infrastructure.

launches.description:
11 | A New Narrative in Web3 Privacy & Cryptography

Born on November 11, 2026, at 11:11:11 — ushering in a new era of privacy with 11!

In the digital world, 0 represents the void, while 1 represents existence. Everything in blockchain technology is built upon the fundamental binary foundation of 0 and 1.

11 (ONEONE) represents a bold exploration beyond traditional binary thinking.

The two parallel and symmetrical “1”s symbolize the two essential pillars of Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP): the Prover and the Verifier.

Through Zero-Knowledge Proof technology, it embraces a powerful cryptographic principle: verifying the truth without revealing the underlying private information.

🔐 Core Narrative: ZKP × Privacy Computing × Decentralization

Bridging the gap between on-chain transparency and personal privacy, 11 explores a new model of trust — one where privacy no longer has to be sacrificed for blockchain innovation.

11 is more than just a number. It is a symbol of privacy, freedom, and trust.

Long-term vision: a continuously operated, multi-network research infrastructure that connects authority, events and observed fund relations with inspectable plans, time-stamped records and measured monitoring, serving individuals through a guided interface and organizations through an API and permitted reports.

EXITP official mint: 5vPz2s8NtkasmVRDz5ySz27V1E8UdSpzqc9xN678jups. Standard SPL Token, 6 decimals, 1 billion tokens, mint authority and freeze authority null. The token carries no live usage right today: token payment for the API Pass is planned, not live. Holding EXITP grants no credits, income or return. Only this mint is official. launches.name: Artificial intelligence is one of the biggest technological shifts since the int
launches.description:
Artificial intelligence is one of the biggest technological shifts since the internet.

We gave it our data.
Connected it to our tools.
Started trusting it with our systems.

Now attackers are using those same capabilities against us.

AI-assisted intrusions. Stolen customer data. Attacks that move faster than security teams can respond.

Chainalysis disclosed an intrusion involving “offensive agentic techniques.” Microsoft documented AI-assisted attacks that, in some cases, reached privileged cloud access in under three hours.

Think about what that means.
Your money, your identity, your business, your private conversations. So much of your life depends on connected systems staying secure.
What happens when attacking those systems becomes faster, cheaper, and easier to scale?

It doesn’t take the entire internet going down to shake people’s trust.

It takes a bank account they can’t access.
A company that can’t protect their information.
A private message that becomes public.

The more capable AI becomes, the bigger the question gets:

Who else can use that power against you?

$ACT
 was The AI Prophecy.

$ACTX is The AI Threat.

The technology is advancing.
The attacks are evolving.
The fear has a name.

launches.description:
🥔 What is SPUD?

SPUD is the first meme coin built with real-world utility at its core.

It’s the first meme coin ever paired with its own native stablecoin — SPUDUSD — creating a powerful ecosystem designed for both growth and stability.

SPUD also powers SpudPay, the first agriculture-focused payment platform built directly around a meme coin.

What is SpudPay?

SpudPay is a modern payment system designed to fix a broken financial process in agriculture. Today, farmers often wait weeks to get paid after delivering crops, cattle, or dairy. SpudPay changes that.

With SPUD + SPUDUSD:

Instant payments, no delays
Lower fees than traditional banking
Secure, blockchain-based transactions
Built specifically for farmers, processors, and ag businesses


SpudPay replaces outdated banking rails with fast, transparent, and fair payments — putting money back into the hands of the people who produce our food.

SPUD isn’t just a meme — it’s infrastructure for the future of agriculture.

launches.description: CHEMO is a community-driven cryptocurrency created by Loco, a 19-year-old battling stage 4 blood cancer (Acute Myeloid Leukemia, AML). After facing the devastating challenges of cancer and having his previous cryptocurrency wallets compromised and drained, Loco decided to start again with one goal: raising $20,000 to help cover his cancer treatment costs. All creator rewards received from this project are intended to go directly towards funding his treatment and recovery. CHEMO represents hope, resilience, strength and a community coming together to support someone fighting for their future. This is more than just a coin to its creator. It's a personal journey, a second chance and a reminder to never give up, even during life's darkest moments. Every share, message and act of support means the world. Together, we can help give Loco a fighting chance. ❤️

launches.description:
The meme comes from Block’s Dessa announcement: an AI model trained on human speech rather than text. Our parody turns that into a familiar crypto personality—the person who never reads the whitepaper but has the most to say in Spaces.

“Never read the whitepaper. Still took over the Spaces.” captures the joke immediately. The oversized human mouth on a desktop speaker makes the character recognisable, while the disconnected mute button reinforces its personality: professionally unmuted.

The name, mascot, spoken Yap Archive and personalised yap receipts support one coherent idea. Community members can claim the identity through their own unsolicited opinions, endless voice notes and “so basically…” replies. Every long explanation becomes another opportunity to reuse the meme.

Its strongest contrast is zero reading versus unlimited confidence. That gives it relevance beyond the launch headline and plenty of remix potential.

launches.name: Anchoring every launch
PAI is a fixed-supply token on Ethereum whose floor price only rises
launches.description:
PAI is a fixed-supply token on Ethereum whose floor price only rises.

All 500,000 PAI started in one single-sided Uniswap v4 position called the wall, which runs from a $0.10 floor upward. The USDC that buyers pay stays in the wall as a bid, so every PAI in circulation can be sold back at or above the floor, before the swap fee.

Every swap pays a 4.44% fee to the wall. Once a day anyone can call poke(): the wall uses its USDC fees to buy PAI, up to a daily cap, and sends it to the dead address. As PAI is retired, anyone can call terrace() to lift the floor.

There was no presale and there is no team allocation. Everyone, the team included, buys from the same wall. The wall has no owner and nothing can change it.

The contracts are verified on Etherscan.

launches.name: MIST is the private trading terminal for Solana
launches.description:
MIST is the private trading terminal for Solana. It has what a terminal needs (trending, new pairs, top gainers, live charts, the trade tape and one-click buys and sells) and adds the one thing the others leave out: it hides the trader.

Every token you buy lands in its own fresh wallet, called a compartment, derived in your browser from a single seed that only you hold. Compartments are funded through the mist route: you pay a one-time address and a solver pays your position from its own wallet, so no explorer shows your wallet paying it. You can fund from Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Bitcoin, Zcash and more, and it arrives as SOL.

Shield sends your signed order straight to block builders in a private lane, out of sight of sandwich bots. Scatter splits one buy into random slices at random moments so size and timing stop looking like one trader.

MIST is non-custodial. Your seed is made in the tab, encrypted with your passphrase, and every trade is signed in the browser. The server is a stateless relay with no accounts, no cookies and no log, and the code is open source.

$MIST is the token of the terminal.

Trade unseen.
